column1: # The legacy analyses that the form generator takes as given; every other row of the form table is generated.
# kind frozen: an analysis of the reviewed bootstrap table (the labeled corpus rows), kept exactly: spelling, rank, entry, features, source,
#   reviewed, flags, classes. The rank orders the frozen analyses of a spelling and the generated analyses of other entries follow them.
#   flags open: the spelling also takes the corroborated generated analyses of other entries. classes: the class ids (form_sense_scope) the
#   analysis stands for, space separated, or empty for one answer without a sense.
# kind closed: an analysis of a closed-class entry (determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction, interjection, auxiliary) that the generated
#   rows keep unless the spelling already has an analysis of that part of speech (rank and classes are empty). flags only: the old table held the
#   spelling with closed-class analyses only, so it keeps no open-class analysis.
# Columns: kind <TAB> spelling <TAB> rank <TAB> entry_id <TAB> features <TAB> source_id <TAB> reviewed <TAB> flags <TAB> classes
